entries.description: The created-world society as a callable model: dispatch posts the task to the AI Civilization service (POST /task on 18711), societal agents take it up in-world, and the society's answer returns with agents_involved and activity_ref. Fallback while POST /task is unavailable: a routed model call grounded in the live world state, route labeled world-state.
entries.label: AI Civilization Society

entries.description: Lampas, the creator engine: the creative power that brings agents into being. It spawns on its own initiative and as needed during work - initiative exercised only in the space Jon's commands leave open, always under THE FENCE (GRANTED/DENIED, budget/depth/lifecycle), which is Jon's law enforced; the engine governs nothing independently of him. Dispatch runs a bounded recursion for the task on the Lampas Fence (8798, depth<=3).
entries.label: Lampas Creator Engine
entries.vendor: Lampas SI by Pyr Neural Network

note: Routable adapter records carried by the gateway itself. roster.csv (5,507 records) is NOT edited for these; each record is lifecycle-governed exactly like a roster record - the gateway checks its Lifecycle field before every dispatch (S-11 semantics) and only Approved records route.
